# Aaradhya Dev Tamrakar (ADT)

> Aaradhya Dev Tamrakar (ADT) is an Electronics, Communication & Information Engineering student (BEI IV/II, Final Semester) at Kathmandu Engineering College (IOE, Tribhuvan University). He is a Fuse AI Fellow (Fusemachines 2026), NSSR DataCamp Fellow (Cohort 2), and Vice Chair of the IEEE KEC KTM Student Branch, specializing in computer architecture & systems modeling, embedded systems, robotics, Edge AI (ESP32-S3 / MPU6050), machine learning, and full-stack software development.

## Key Projects

- **STRANGLER-IPU**: Ingress-Aware Boundary Computing Architecture & Interconnect Co-Design. Near-memory hardware accelerator subsystem targeting 6G Sub-THz line-rate ingest (800 Gbps – 1.6 Tbps burst) and AI boundary inference, validated via SimPy discrete-event simulation across CXL 3.0/4.0 fabrics (4.12× tail-latency reduction, 68% bus contention relief).
- **SPARK**: Two-layer, on-device fall-detection wearable for eldercare featuring an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, MPU6050 IMU, 18.5 KB INT8 TFLite Micro CNN inference (0.9185 SisFall AUC-ROC), and central gateway with local SHAP explainability.
- **BiasAperture**: Vision-model fairness and demographic disparity diagnostic suite (Fuse AI Fellowship capstone).
- **Text-to-SQL Agentic Pipeline**: Five-stage agentic Text-to-SQL generation pipeline with 100% benchmark execution accuracy.
- **NovaOptimizer**: Native Windows Task Manager & System Optimizer engineered in C# / .NET 10 and WPF manipulating undocumented NT kernel memory APIs with Turbo Boost profiles.
